title: Construction Paralegal
description:
Construction Paralegal, Cambridgeshire - Up to circa £30k - A leading regional law firm is looking to appoint a Paralegal to support the Senior Construction Lawyer. To apply or to register your interest, please contact Cassie on or email with your CV.

JOB TITLE: Construction Paralegal
PQE: 1 + years' experience
LOCATION: Cambridgeshire
SALARY: Up to circa £30k

OVERVIEW:
- An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Construction Paralegal to join an established and support the Senior Lawyer specialising in construction law.
- Supporting on complex matters, this opportunity would suit someone looking to progress their career within a progressive firm.
- The firm are looking for paralegals with experience of working in a firm ideally within construction or corporate / commercial work.
- You will be able to demonstrate a strong sense of commercial acumen and a genuine desire to contribute to the department's ongoing success.
- Candidates should be technically strong and IT literate and possess good time management and organisational capabilities.
- A highly respected UK law firm with an established reputation for delivering excellent client service across a range of disciplines.
- The firm offers a collaborative working environment and a superb opportunity to join a forward-thinking firm that continues to invest in its people.

HOW TO APPLY:
Contact Cassie Huxtable at eNL on or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion.

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications in 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE/salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever your ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.

title: Family Legal PA
description:
Family Legal PA (Part-Time)

Huntingdon & St Neots 3-4 Days Per Week Competitive Salary

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Legal PA or legal support professional to join a highly respected law firm with an outstanding reputation for both client service and staff wellbeing. Known for its supportive culture, long-serving employees and commitment to creating a positive working environment, the firm is seeking dedicated individuals to support its busy Family Law team on a part-time basis.

These positions are ideal for candidates looking for a long-term Legal PA career within a well-established family department, rather than a role intended as a route into qualification or fee-earning work.

Working closely with experienced family lawyers, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of matters, providing high-quality administrative and organisational support across a varied and sensitive caseload.

The Role

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing day-to-day PA and administrative support to Family Law solicitors.
- Preparing, organising and managing electronic court bundles using Bundledocs.
- Opening and closing client files in line with firm procedures.
- Assisting with dictated work, correspondence and legal documentation.
- Conducting client identification, anti-money laundering and conflict checks.
- Supporting lawyers with family court portals, document submissions and important court deadlines.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring files are managed efficiently.

About You
- Previous experience as a Legal PA, Legal Secretary or legal support professional.
- Family law experience ideally, particularly within bundle preparation and court-related processes.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Experience handling legal file administration and compliance procedures.
- Familiarity with AML checks, client onboarding and conflict checks.
- Knowledge of Bundledocs and family court systems would be advantageous.
- A genuine interest in family law and a desire to build a stable, long-term career within legal support.

Candidates from other legal disciplines will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong transferable skills and a genuine interest in working within a Family Law team.

Why Apply?
- Join a highly regarded and established law firm.
- Supportive, friendly and collaborative working culture.
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced family law specialists.
- Stable, long-term Legal PA role with genuine job security.
- Flexible part-time working arrangement.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you are an experienced Legal PA seeking a rewarding part-time opportunity with a firm that genuinely values and supports its people, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

To apply or find out more, please get in touch for a confidential discussion today.

title: Legal PA
description:
Owen Reed is looking for a proactive and organised Legal PA to join the Private department of a law firm in Cambridge.

Working as part of the Legal Operations team, you will provide timely, high-quality administrative and coordination support to a group of lawyers. This varied role includes client contact, matter management, billing, diary management and travel coordination, working within a friendly and high-performing team.

The successful candidate will be self-motivated and reliable, with the ability to manage their workload, plan ahead and adapt to changing priorities while consistently delivering accurate work to deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Matter Management
- Support fee earners and Senior Legal PAs throughout the client and matter lifecycle, following documented procedures.
- Work closely with client onboarding and compliance specialists to ensure all required information and documentation is obtained, issued and correctly stored.
- Support compliance with policies covering new matters, retainer letters, conflict checks, searches, Client Due Diligence and Know Your Client requirements.
- Maintain electronic and hard-copy documents in accordance with the firm's filing protocols.
- Ensure inactive matters are closed, client funds are returned and files are archived promptly.

Financial Management & Billing
- Develop a strong understanding of billing processes and systems to support the preparation of accurate bills and financial information.
- Ensure matters are set up with the correct rates, discounts and billing details, and that Money on Account is collected or files are recorded on the exempt list.
- Help monitor and address unpaid bills, liaising with Credit Control where required.
- Support the accurate and timely processing of disbursement invoices and payments.

Fee Earner Support
- Act as a first point of contact for assigned fee earners, handling calls, emails, correspondence and meeting requests, responding on their behalf where appropriate.
- Manage calendars across multiple time zones, scheduling calls and meetings and following up as needed.
- Assist with expense claims and other business-related requirements.

Travel Coordination
- Manage travel arrangements through the firm's in-house travel provider.
- Prepare itineraries and ensure business expenses are captured, approved and processed in accordance with policy.

Business Development
- Organise business breakfasts, lunches and dinners, including associated expenses.
- Record referrals and contacts in InterAction and maintain CRM lists.

Delegation & Coordination
- Work with Business Administrators to coordinate filing, archiving, scanning, photocopying, contact updates and courier arrangements.
- Delegate document formatting, production, typing, amendments, house styling and proofreading to the Document Production Unit as appropriate.
- Liaise with Legal Support Services, the Global Capability Centre and other departments to obtain specialist input or delegate tasks, retaining ownership and following up where required.

Team Support & Collaboration
- Contribute to a cohesive working environment and provide cover for Senior Legal PAs and other Legal Operations colleagues.
- Work flexibly across Legal Operations teams to meet business needs.
- Take responsibility for your workload, communicate working arrangements clearly and follow through on commitments.
- Demonstrate the firm's core values and support its Equity, Diversity and Inclusion strategy.
- Develop a focus area or specialism to build skills and contribute to service improvement, innovation and engagement across Legal Support Services.

Skills & Experience
- Previous administrative experience supporting a team within a similar professional services environment, ideally legal.
- Strong time management skills, with the ability to balance multiple tasks, plan ahead and respond positively to changing requirements.
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills and a willingness to learn new systems.
- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure.
- An organised, methodical approach and confidence working within structured processes and compliance frameworks.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with different people and working styles.
- A collaborative approach, with the flexibility to support additional fee earners and wider team requirements.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including drafting professional business correspondence.
- Discretion and sound judgement when handling sensitive or confidential information.
